title: nixos/immichframe: add systemd hardening; fix flaky x11 test
watch_selection_basis: PR diff (`gh pr diff 540256`) touches nixos/modules/services/web-apps/immichframe.nix and nixos/tests/web-apps/immichframe.nix. The module change is entirely inside the existing `systemd.services.immichframe.serviceConfig = { ... }` block (adds ~25 systemd hardening directives: CapabilityBoundingSet, ProtectSystem, RestrictAddressFamilies, SystemCallFilter, etc.) -- a service-config change, not an option declaration. No mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule/etc. declaration line is touched (confirmed: module's only options block declares just `enable = mkEnableOption "ImmichFrame";` at line 19, untouched by the diff). The test-file changes (switch from a kiosk-window xdotool approach to a real user-session X11 login via ../common/user-account.nix, plus maintainer metadata) are test-harness fixes unrelated to option surface. Only the baseline `enable` option was watched.
